path.description: Database file path relative to the workspace root, for example data/shop.sqlite3. Absolute paths, '..' and links that leave the root are refused.

tables.description: Describe only these tables and views. For a large database, call with names_only true first to see the names.

names_only.description: true lists only the name and type of each table and view (at most 1000), without columns.

count_rows.description: true adds the row count of each table (slow on large tables).

time_limit_ms.description: Stop the work after this many milliseconds.
